reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and nothing here says the fixtures are UL listed, which my electrician will ask about before he hangs anything. With him back in three weeks and 10 to 12 business days of shipping (or six weeks if it's made to order), I'm not risking a lighting order on a store I can't vouch for.
objection: Is it UL listed and safe, and will my electrician install it? I see no certification, no reviews and no name I know, and I'd pay return shipping on a heavy fixture if it turns out wrong.
would_change_my_mind: Clear UL or ETL listing on the product page, real customer photos and reviews, and a guaranteed in-stock delivery date before the electrician comes, plus free return shipping.
